versions.changelog:
- Initial release of automation-dedup-guard.
- Detects and removes duplicate WorkBuddy automation tasks, keeping only the newest for each name group.
- Cleans up associated automation run records for deleted tasks.
- Supports dry-run (preview), custom database path, and verbose debug output.
- Auto-detects WorkBuddy database location across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Designed for Python 3.6+; uses only standard library (no external dependencies).
- Suitable for manual or scheduled (recurring) cleanup to prevent automation task bloat.
